read.title: Glow Set Giveaway
read.text:
GIVEAWAY TIME!

To thank you for your support this year, we are giving away our full Glow Set to five lucky followers.

How to enter:
Follow our account, like this post, and tag two friends in the comments. Share this post to your Stories for a bonus entry.

Entries close on Sunday at midnight. Five winners will be chosen at random, and we will announce them on our Stories on Tuesday. Winners will be contacted by direct message from this account only, so please watch out for fake accounts.

This giveaway is open to residents of the United States and Canada aged 18 or over. It is not sponsored by or connected with Instagram.

Good luck!

write.en: Write an Instagram giveaway caption for a new lip balm launch, including how to enter, the closing date, and how winners will be announced.
write.model: Our new Berry Lip Balm is here, and we are celebrating with a giveaway! Follow us, like this post, and tag one friend for a chance to win a set of three lip balms. Entries close on Friday at 6 p.m. Ten winners will be chosen at random, and we will announce them on our Stories on Monday. Good luck!
